name: Qing Mao Mountain
ref: Wiki: Qing Mao Mountain; Ch. 60; Ch. 183
look: Grass grass_lush/grass_dark by slope; slopes >0.9 rock; soil band soil_blue_black on cut banks
notes: Heightfield from TERRAIN JSON. Single peak north of centre; fore (south) slope descends to the river.

name: Yellow Dragon River
ref: Ch. 117; Ch. 200; Wiki: Yellow Dragon River
look: water_yellow, opacity 0.9, foam strips white at banks
notes: Main course along the south edge, flowing east. Polyline rivers.yellow_dragon_river.

name: Gu Yue Village Wall and Gates
look: Timber palisade timber_dark 6 m, walkway inside with ladders; towers 10 m bamboo_green roofs
notes: Rect x -115..115, z 20..235. Gates N(0,20) S(0,235) E(115,130) W(-115,130); S is the main gate. 8 towers: 4 corners + 2 flanking each of S and N gates.

name: Gu Yue Bamboo Houses
look: bamboo_green walls, bamboo_jade highlights, roof_bamboo; stilts timber
notes: 240 instanced houses inside the wall, rejecting other footprints and roads (2 m clearance). Narrow 3 m lanes.

name: Gu Yue Clan Pavilion
look: 5 storeys timber_dark, roof_tile with sharply upswept eaves, lacquer_red trim, lanterns each eave
notes: Faces south onto the square. Holds tablets, conference hall and the stair down to the spring cave (portal P1 at (0,92)).

name: Pavilion Square
look: stone_paving grey slabs 2x2 m
notes: On the flattened terrace south of the pavilion. Morning gathering place of the Awakening Ceremony.

name: Main Mountain Road
look: packed earth path_earth 5 m; stone steps where grade >0.35
notes: Polyline paths.main_road: river landing -> 5 switchbacks -> S gate -> square -> west of pavilion -> N gate. 813 m.

name: Ch. 1 Light Band
look: lantern_warm emissive points, 2400 total
notes: Lights on house windows/eaves (1900) and every 12 m along main_road down to the foot (500). Night only. Reads as one bright band from foot to mountainside.

name: Xiong Village
look: 70 stilt houses in xiong_timber with hide_awning roofs; log palisade 4 m; 1 gate north-east
notes: Lowest of the three villages, bench at y 21 on the fore slope near the foot.

name: Bai Village
look: 60 houses in bai_timber with roof_bai; pale stone wall 4 m; 1 gate west
notes: On the back-mountain bench (y 60) directly beside the deep pool east of it.

name: Back-Mountain Waterfall and Deep Pool
look: Falling sheet water_fall 14 m wide, mist puff sprites mist; pool water_pool
notes: Lip at (60,-345) y 97 drops 38 m to the pool, centre (60,-395) r 28, surface y 59. Outlet east at (88,-400).

name: Alliance Slope
look: trampled earth path_earth with stone_paving border 3 m
notes: Giant square, long axis north-south, running along the rock wall that rises on its east side.

name: Spear Bamboo Forest
look: Straight stalks bamboo_green to bamboo_jade, sharp tips, no branches; grass + white_flower ground cover
notes: 5000 instanced stalks around the village wall, densest east of the academy toward the rock crack. Excludes walls, roads, water, footprints.

name: Spring Cave (Stalactite Hall)
look: cave_rock walls; 60 stalactites emissive in the 7 rainbow colours
notes: Reached by stone stair from portal P1. A shallow 3 m-wide underground stream crosses its east end.

name: Gu Yue Spirit Spring
look: Clear water_spring with faint starry glow spring_glow, sand bed; crystal_wall arc on its east side
notes: Dark corner at the far end of the orchid sea. Village foundation. Crystal wall faces the inheritance passage.

name: Waterfall Tributary
look: water_trib, cascades white foam where grade >0.2
notes: Drains the deep pool east and south around the mountain to the main river at (440,460). Polyline rivers.waterfall_tributary.

name: Gu Yue Academy
look: 2-storey bamboo hall bamboo_green, roof_tile, long east-facing window row
notes: East side of the village so its windows overlook the spear bamboo grove. Gu room inside.

name: Academy Dormitories
look: Long bamboo house, roof_bamboo
notes: Beside the academy, north. Position free (no canon placement).

name: Medicine Hall
look: Bamboo hall, herb racks timber, roof_bamboo
notes: Position free (no canon placement).

name: Punishment Hall
look: Dark hall timber_dark, roof_tile, no lanterns
notes: Position free (no canon placement).

name: Village Tavern
look: Bamboo house with wine jars clay_jar stacked outside, 4 lanterns
notes: Inside the main (S) gate, where taverns stand. Sells green bamboo wine.

name: Alliance Rock Building
look: Carved into rock: rock_dark facade, balcony at y 60 with stone railing
notes: Cut into the rock wall on the square's east side; balcony overlooks the square.

name: Rock Crack Entrance
look: Boulder rock with a 0.8 m vertical crevice, moss streaks moss; branch fall water_fall 1.5 m wide over it
notes: Boulder set against the vertical knob wall; portal P2 into the secret cave. Branch waterfall from rockcrack_stream.

name: Flower Wine Monk Secret Cave
look: red_earth walls emissive 0.25, damp moss patches, withered vines; image wall 0.9 m high on west wall
notes: Inside the knob wall (about 80 m2). West wall is the image wall; the inheritance tunnel starts behind it.

name: Inheritance Tunnel
look: red_earth tube, stoop-height 1.5 m first 15 m then 2.5 m; round boulder rock on the incline; rock_door slab

name: Rock Forest
look: 40 inverted pillars red_pillar hanging from ceiling, pitted holes, glow 0.15; bigger toward centre
notes: Central pillar nearly touches floor; crude stair under it descends west to the spring's crystal wall.

name: Moon Orchid Flower Sea
look: 1200 instanced orchids moon_orchid, emissive 0.3 at night/cutaway
notes: Past the stream; walk 50 steps (35 m) from its west edge to the spring.

name: Blood Pond Graveyard
look: Dome of red_earth glowing 0.3; pond blood_water emissive; 60 ceiling holes with thin water threads
notes: Directly below the spring, deepest space. Coffin stays submerged (baseline). Shaft from spring floor.

name: Gu Yue Mortal Hamlets
look: 3 clusters of 12 small single-storey huts thatch roofs, fields field_green
notes: Merged from tens of hamlets. Clusters at x -60, 30, 105.

name: Xiong Mortal Hamlets
look: 1 cluster of 14 huts thatch
notes: Below Xiong Village at the foot.

name: Bai Mortal Hamlets
look: 1 cluster of 12 huts thatch
notes: Back-mountain foot below Bai Village.

name: Tributary Beach
look: Pebble bank sand + rock pebbles
notes: Pebble bank about 160 m east of the rock crack, end of east_lane.

name: Qing Mao Summit
look: 12 jagged rock instances rock_dark, no buildings
notes: Highest point about y 207.

name: Clan Road
look: path_earth 4 m, steps where grade >0.35
notes: Polyline paths.west_clan_road: W gate -> Xiong -> Alliance Slope -> Bai.

name: East Lane
look: path_earth 3 m, fades to trampled grass past the grove
notes: Polyline paths.east_lane: E gate -> grove -> rock crack -> beach.

name: Wolf Den Valley
look: 8 dark den mouths rock_dark in a scrubby hollow, no animals
notes: Lower north-east slope, away from all villages.

name: Upper Stream
look: water_trib ribbon 3 m
notes: Feeds the waterfall lip. Polyline rivers.upper_stream (ribbon, no carving).

name: Branch Waterfall Stream
look: water_trib ribbon 3 m
notes: Source of the branch fall over the rock crack. Ribbons rivers.rockcrack_stream and rockcrack_runoff.

name: Foot Road
look: path_earth 3 m
notes: Polyline paths.foot_road linking the hamlets along the foot.

name: Old Hunter Wang's Tree House
look: Plank hut timber on a tree platform 5 m up, 2 windows
notes: Position free (no canon placement); hidden in forest west of the village.

name: Wildflower Slopes
look: Instanced flower quads in 5 colours flowers_*
notes: Sunny south-facing slopes between village and Xiong.

name: Mountain Mist
look: 24 large soft sprites mist, opacity 0.25, drift 0.3 m/s
notes: Morning mist bands at y 30-70 on the fore slope.
